style: Planetary terrain and rock surfaces for a space adventure game: volcanic, desert, icy, asteroid and earth-like worlds.

cells.name: basalt
cells.prompt: Dark volcanic basalt ground: cooled ropy pahoehoe lava crust with cracks, vesicles and sharp clinker.

cells.name: obsidian
cells.prompt: Black obsidian volcanic glass rock with conchoidal fractures and sharp glossy facets.

cells.name: dune_sand
cells.prompt: Fine desert sand seen from above with regular wind ripples and a few scattered pebbles.

cells.name: sandstone
cells.prompt: Layered red-orange sandstone rock face with horizontal strata, cross-bedding and erosion pockets.

cells.name: snowfield
cells.prompt: Wind-packed snow surface seen from above with sastrugi ridges, small crusts and soft blue shadows.

cells.name: glacier
cells.prompt: Blue glacier ice surface: clear blue ice with white cracks, trapped bubbles and frost.

cells.name: asteroid
cells.prompt: Grey asteroid surface: pitted lunar-like rock and regolith dust with many small craters and rubble.

cells.name: earth_ground
cells.prompt: Natural ground seen from above: patchy short grass, bare soil, small stones and a few fallen leaves.

cells.name: mossy_rock
cells.prompt: Grey stone surface partly covered in thick green moss and small ferns in the cracks.
